content.text: Create a single continuous 4-second vertical 9:16 shot. An overhead beauty demonstration showing only two adult hands and the back of one hand, no face or person visible. One smooth cosmetic spatula applies a small amount of translucent cosmetic gel to a small area on the back of the other hand in a single clean stroke. Soft blush studio tabletop background, clean realistic skin and natural anatomy, stable camera. No visible change in skin quality or tone, no before/after, no medical claims. The product tube is outside the frame. This is a staged illustrative application scene for the referenced Medicube Collagen Night Wrapping Mask, not footage of a real efficacy test. No cuts, no captions, no new logos, no music, no speech.
